meta.scope: Power 4 plus Notre Dame football head coaches, 2026 season
meta.notes: Maps a cited contract step-down onto remaining 2026 games. The buyout in force after a kickoff is the step that covers the next calendar day — not a renegotiation after each Saturday. Paid buyouts (already-owed money after a firing) live on the tape/layers desk, not here.

Wikipedia 2026 FBS team pages for current HCs and schedules

florida.name: Jon Sumrall
florida.rule: If Florida terminates without cause: 70% of remaining annualized compensation, paid in equal monthly installments through Dec. 31, 2031. $7.45 million per contract year. No public current-dollar overhang is on this desk; we will not multiply 70% × remaining years ourselves.
florida.notes: Billy Napier’s $21.2M is a paid-buyout, not this tool. Coach-side liquidated damages if Sumrall walks ($10M in 2026, then $8/$3/$2/$1/$0) are a separate schedule.

mitigation.rule: School-side 70% buyout is reduced if Sumrall accepts an NFL or Division I coaching or front-office job. He is not required to take one. We do not invent a dollar offset.

source.label: Gainesville Sun (Dec. 1, 2025), quoting UF payment details

contract.label: Gainesville Sun / UF released payment details (Dec. 1, 2025)

florida-state.name: Mike Norvell

steps.rule: If fired without cause during the 2026 season — 85% of remaining base salary and supplemental pay through Dec. 31, 2031. CBS Sports (July 16, 2026) put the after-2025 / in-season-2026 figure at roughly $58.4 million. The contract year ends Dec. 31; it does not step after each Saturday.

source.label: CBS Sports 2026 hot-seat rankings (July 16, 2026)

steps.rule: After the 2026 season ends, CBS Sports estimated the buyout drops to $45.6 million. Still 85% of remaining compensation; remaining contract years run through Dec. 31, 2031.

source.label: CBS Sports 2026 hot-seat rankings (July 16, 2026)

florida-state.notes: Rule confirmed by CBS Sports (Nov. 16, 2025 contract review) and the Tallahassee Democrat / USA TODAY Sports (Nov. 21, 2025), both quoting the employment agreement: 85% of remaining base and supplemental pay, payable lump-sum or in monthly installments through 2031. The desk’s last USA TODAY if-fired overhang was $58,667,708 as of Oct. 8, 2025 — the same order of magnitude as the $58.4 million 2026-season step. We do not mint a weekly staircase.

mitigation.rule: Norvell must use best efforts to obtain full-time comparable employment at a market-rate salary. If he is hired, Florida State’s remaining termination amount is reduced dollar-for-dollar by what he earns during the termination period. We do not invent a dollar offset.

source.label: Tallahassee Democrat / USA TODAY Sports (Nov. 21, 2025), quoting the contract
